excerpt.zh:
根据目前观察，在[breathing_rift_object.GetName]发现的异常现象似乎是极为罕见的空间裂隙。很有可能是[breathing_rift_object.GetName]的巨大质量帮助其生成，但我们目前尚无法理解其性质。

裂隙不仅会折射和阻挡光线，而且似乎还会吸引光线后再将其吐出，如此往复——有如呼吸一般。

目前看来，裂隙巨大的引力很可能也拉入过其他东西。我们最好小心行事。

texts.zh:
根据目前观察，在[breathing_rift_object.GetName]发现的异常现象似乎是极为罕见的空间裂隙。很有可能是[breathing_rift_object.GetName]的巨大质量帮助其生成，但我们目前尚无法理解其性质。

裂隙不仅会折射和阻挡光线，而且似乎还会吸引光线后再将其吐出，如此往复——有如呼吸一般。

目前看来，裂隙巨大的引力很可能也拉入过其他东西。我们最好小心行事。
texts.en:
The anomaly found close by [breathing_rift_object.GetName], however unlikely, appears to be some type of rift in space. It's possible the great mass of [breathing_rift_object.GetName] somehow caused it, but its nature is beyond our understanding.

The rift not only refracts and blocks light, but seems to actually draw it in and then push it out, repeatedly - as if it were breathing photons.

It is likely the immense gravitational pull of the rift has at some point inhaled in other things, as well. We should exercise caution.

label.zh: 有进一步发现之前，一定要紧密观察。
label.en: Keep a close watch until we know more.

label.zh: 我们可以从安全距离进行观察研究。
label.en: It can be studied from a safe distance.
The [Root.GetName] is at risk. Leave now.

texts.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品是小行星的遗留碎片，其中大部分仍然富含矿物。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
texts.en:
Once again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] has released a sizeable gathering of items. This time it's remnants of an asteroid, many of them laden with minerals.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

texts.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量富含矿物的岩石从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
texts.en:
Many months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] without anything out of the ordinary happening. But now, we have received reports of a large gathering of mineral-laden rocks pouring out of it.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

texts.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品漂流进入该星系的碎料，也许是某次古代战斗留下的遗迹吧。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
texts.en:
Again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] spews out something new. This time it is mostly metal debris, perhaps from some ancient battle. It is ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

texts.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量碎料从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
texts.en:
Many uneventful months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName]. But now, we have received reports of a great stream of debris pouring out of it. It is ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

texts.zh: 从观察裂隙的勘测器传来的最新数据表明，裂隙已经消失了。吸入最后一口气之后，裂隙自动关闭，且未留下任何其曾经存在过的能源痕迹。
texts.en: The latest data report from the rift's observation probe tells us that the rift has vanished. After drawing its last breath, the rift closed and left behind not even a trace of its energies.

texts.zh: 观察[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近发现的空间裂隙，等着看里面会冒出什么东西。
texts.en: Observe the rift in space discovered near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] and await whatever comes out of it, if anything.
